purpose: Use only frozen raw outputs to distinguish attachment-replacement activation-veto insufficiency from region-level merge granularity as the cause of the nine unresolved v6 regression observations.

experiments.hypothesis: The nine residual errors persist primarily because v6 activation compatibility vetoes a correct replacement attachment; making the attachment family oracle-perfect while holding surface candidates and every non-attachment family fixed should therefore resolve all nine.
experiments.causal_question: Is a perfect attachment-family replacement alone sufficient to make every unresolved observation exact?
experiments.baseline: Frozen v6 regression raw, without executing any parser.
experiments.intervention: For every target, replace only the attachment family with its frozen v4-compatible reference. For projection-only observations this changes only example projection; for the full-graph legacy observation this changes example_attachments and example projection. Keep surface items, item candidates, wrappers, connector labels, coordinations, and shared scopes byte-identical to frozen v6.
experiments.primary_outcome: complete resolved target count across all layers available in frozen raw
acceptance_criteria: All 9 targets are exact after attachment-family replacement.
All non-attachment payloads are byte-identical to frozen v6.
All 22 resolved controls remain byte-identical and exact.
No parser, model, network, canonicalizer, or cumulative E9 treatment is used.
experiments.falsification: Reject attachment replacement as a sufficient explanation if even one target remains inexact or any held-fixed family changes.
experiments.interpretation_limit: Projection-only records expose example output but not full attachment topology. Passing would establish sufficiency on frozen observable layers only; failing still permits attachment replacement to contribute to earlier G2/G4 misses outside these nine residual observations.

experiments.hypothesis: The nine residual errors are caused by choosing one parser for an entire region when different node families within that region require different frozen parser outputs.
experiments.causal_question: Does oracle selection at node-family granularity resolve all nine residual observations while retaining already-correct v6 families, compared with the frozen v6 region-level arm?
experiments.baseline: Frozen v6 regression raw, independently reloaded; no E8 output is loaded.
experiments.intervention: For targets only, the whole-region oracle uses the frozen v4-compatible reference payload. The node-family oracle independently selects the v4-compatible reference only for an inexact observable family and retains the frozen v6 value for every exact family. Projection-only families are surface_items and examples; the legacy full-graph families are wrappers, connector labels, coordination members, shared scopes, example attachments, surface items, and examples.
primary_outcomes: complete resolved target count by arm
changed observable family count by arm
retained exact v6 family count by arm
acceptance_criteria: The node-family arm resolves all 9 targets on every available frozen layer.
The node-family arm changes no family that was already exact under frozen v6.
The node-family arm changes no more observable families than whole-region fallback.
All 22 resolved controls are byte-identical in every arm.
No parser, model, network, canonicalizer, target-derived production rule, or E8 output is used.
experiments.falsification: Reject node-family granularity as sufficient if any target remains inexact, any already-correct family changes, or any control changes.
experiments.interpretation_limit: This is a gold-directed diagnostic oracle. It can identify the necessary merge granularity but cannot identify a deployable runtime selector. Projection-only observations cannot establish unobserved topology correctness.

decision_rule.winner: A mechanism is called sufficient only if its own independent gate passes. If both pass, prefer the mechanism changing fewer observable families; if neither passes, preregister a new residual mechanism without modifying v6.
decision_rule.post_experiment: Freeze both results. Do not implement v7 until the supported causal mechanism is translated into a separate v7 preregistration with runtime-identifiable, non-fixture-specific activation rules.
